purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: What changed at federal financial agencies, September 30–October 2
question: What materially changed across the federal monetary, prudential, securities, derivatives, systemic-risk and public-credit institutions after the September 30 post-noon close?
bluf: The SEC changed one voting rule, DTC proposed better registration messages and audit trails, the Federal Reserve added data connections, CFTC relief was extended and NCUA closed an insolvent credit union. Other announcements remained plans or approvals without public spending records.
evidence_cutoff_note: The window starts strictly after September 30 at 12:21:42 p.m. ET with inclusive replay of date-only September 30 sources. The focused monitor selected 56 routes across 55 URLs, reached 53 and was blocked on three SEC routes; Federal Register/Public Inspection and exact issuer records supplied alternate custody. General tax, sanctions and statistical work was excluded unless it changed a covered institution's authority, finance, market or operating state.
use_note: Use as the bounded September 30 boundary-to-October 2 receipt. Follow detailed DTC and Fed claims to the fed-clearing-treasury owner, and preserve adoption, publication, effectiveness, implementation, operation, payment and observed effect as separate clocks.
entities: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
Export-Import Bank of the United States

availability_semantics.public_reading: The public site contains both the original public view and a crawler-friendly static HTML reading edition. public_full_text is true.
availability_semantics.public_machine_data: The public site contains the complete positively selected structured dataset. public_full_text is true; reading_url and data_url identify the canonical JSON object.
availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. public_full_text is false and access_state is private_by_design. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
